material_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Porch Ceiling Repaint
material_systems.description: 100% acrylic exterior stain-blocking primer for previously painted porch ceiling surfaces where existing paint has failed or peeled, exposing bare wood substrate. Spot prime when localized failure; full prime on SS_EXT_PEELING. Not used on SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (skip prime) or SS_EXT_CHALKING (use chalk-binding instead). Overhead application increases waste ~10%.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec EXT Primer
products.notes: Stain-blocking adhesion primer for exposed bare wood on porch ceiling where paint failed or peeled. Spot prime scraped bare areas when localized; full prime when SS_EXT_PEELING.

prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: spot prime scraped bare wood areas; full prime if widespread bare exposure
prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_PEELING: full surface prime after heavy scrape to sound substrate

material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC primer. Same product family as SYS_EXT_SFRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC_RP (soffit RP). Overhead application increases waste ~10%.

material_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Porch Ceiling
material_systems.description: Low-viscosity chalk-binding conditioner primer for SS_EXT_CHALKING porch ceiling. MANDATORY regardless of substrate material. Full surface application. Higher material consumption due to aggressive absorption by chalk residue. Less common on porch ceiling than siding (sheltered from UV) but occurs on south-facing exposed porches.

products.notes: MANDATORY for chalking porch ceiling. Penetrates and binds loose chalk. Full surface — no exceptions. Overhead drips more than vertical.

material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC primer. Same product family as SYS_EXT_SFRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND (soffit RP).

material_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Bare Fiber Cement Porch Ceiling
material_systems.description: Alkali-resistant acrylic masonry primer for exposed bare fiber cement areas where paint has failed or peeled. Required for bare/damaged FC (pH 13.0). In RP, applied as spot primer on exposed bare FC areas. Reuses NC system unchanged.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec Masonry & Stucco Primer
products.notes: MANDATORY on exposed bare fiber cement. Prevents saponification at pH 13.0. Spot prime in RP context.

prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: spot prime exposed bare fiber cement areas
prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_PEELING: spot prime all exposed FC areas; full prime if extensive failure

material_systems.notes: Reused from NC spec SYS_EXT_PRCH_PRIMER_ALKALI. Spot application mode in RP.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Porch Ceiling Paint
material_systems.description: 100% acrylic exterior paint with mildewcide for porch ceiling surfaces. QT2: 1 coat. QT3: 2 coats. Flat/satin only. Mildew-resistant formulation recommended for all porch ceiling work due to sheltered, damp conditions.

products.product_type: 100% acrylic exterior ceiling/porch paint with mildewcide
products.notes: Mildewcide additive recommended. Flat is default porch ceiling sheen.

material_systems.notes: Reused from NC spec. Same product in RP context.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Porch Ceiling Paint
material_systems.description: Premium 100% acrylic exterior paint with enhanced mildew resistance. QT4: 2 coats with interstage sand.

products.notes: Premium materials. Enhanced mildew resistance. Intercoat sand at QT4.

coverage_profiles.notes: RP spot prime on exposed bare fiber cement.
